title: Account Coordinator
description:
Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator)

Location: Hull
Salary: 27,700 per annum
Hours: 40 hours per week
Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Join the Stafforce Team

At Stafforce, we're passionate about connecting people with opportunities and helping our clients build reliable, skilled workforces. We are looking for a proactive and organised Candidate Consultant (Account Coordinator) to join our team, supporting a number of key client accounts across the Hull area.
This is a varied, fast-paced role where no two days are the same. You'll play a vital part in the candidate journey, from sourcing and onboarding workers through to supporting their assignments and ensuring our clients receive an outstanding service.

The Role

As a Candidate Consultant, you will work closely with our recruitment and account management teams to support the delivery of temporary workforce solutions. You will be responsible for coordinating worker onboarding, conducting inductions, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring workers are fully supported throughout their employment.
This role is primarily office-based but will involve travel to client sites across the Hull area to support onboarding and workforce activities.
The standard working hours are 8:30am to 5:00pm, Monday to Friday, however flexibility is essential as some client requirements may require early starts. You will also participate in an out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota to support our clients and workforce when needed.

Key Responsibilities
- Support recruitment activities by sourcing and coordinating suitable candidates.
- Conduct candidate registrations and onboarding processes.
- Deliver worker inductions and site briefings.
- Complete compliance checks, right-to-work verification, and employment documentation.
- Maintain accurate records using Stafforce's internal systems and databases.
- Update and manage workforce data using Microsoft Excel and other software packages.
- Build strong relationships with candidates, workers, clients, and colleagues.
- Monitor worker attendance and assist with shift coordination.
- Support workforce planning and fulfil client staffing requirements.
- Resolve worker queries and provide ongoing support throughout assignments.
- Ensure all processes are completed accurately and in line with company procedures.
- Participate in the out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota.
- Travel between client sites and offices as required.

What We're Looking For
Essential Skills & Experience
- Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
- Strong IT and administrative skills.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Confident using databases, software systems, and Microsoft Office applications.
- Excellent organisational skills with strong attention to detail.
- Ability to prioritise workload and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.
- A flexible and positive approach to work.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in recruitment, account coordination, administration, customer service, or a similar role.
- Experience working with temporary workers or high-volume staffing environments.
- Full UK driving licence due to travel requirements across multiple client locations in the Hull area.

What You'll Receive

In return, Stafforce offers a supportive environment where you can develop your career and make a real difference to both candidates and clients.

Benefits Include:
- Competitive salary of 27,700 per annum.
- Full training and ongoing development opportunities.
- Career progression within a well-established and growing business.
- 24/7 GP access through our employee wellbeing programme.
- Emotional wellbeing and mental health support.
- High street discounts across a wide range of retailers, restaurants, leisure providers, and services.
- Access to a supportive and collaborative team culture.

S15

About Us

We are dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive community. In line with our Diversity and Inclusion policy, we welcome applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or disability. As a Disability Confident Employer, and part of the Nicholas Associates Group, we are committed to supporting candidates with disabilities, and we're happy to discuss flexible working options.

We are committed to protecting the privacy of all our candidates and clients. If you choose to apply, your information will be processed in accordance with the Nicholas Associates Group of companies Privacy Notice.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Are you an organised, proactive and friendly administrator looking for a flexible part-time opportunity within education? Tradewind Recruitment is currently seeking a reliable and experienced College Administrator to join a busy college in central Hull. This is to start ASAP, is a temporary position, and will initially last until about 18th December 2026.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an administrator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys supporting students and staff, and takes pride in keeping an educational setting running smoothly.

The Role
- Position: College Administrator
- Location: Central Hull
- Hours: 8:30am-4:30pm
- Working pattern: 2 days per week, with flexibility on which two days
- Pay rate: 15.00- 16.50 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications
- Recruitment agency: Tradewind Recruitment

Key Responsibilities

As a College Administrator, you will play a vital role in the day-to-day running of the college, providing efficient administrative support to teaching staff, students, senior leaders and visitors.

General Administration
- Providing comprehensive administrative support to the college office and wider staff team.
- Managing incoming telephone calls, emails and general enquiries in a professional and friendly manner.
- Welcoming visitors, students, parents and external professionals, ensuring they are directed to the appropriate departments.
- Maintaining accurate records, filing systems and confidential documentation.
- Typing, preparing, formatting and distributing letters, reports, correspondence and other college documents.
- Photocopying, scanning, printing and collating paperwork and teaching resources.
- Managing incoming and outgoing post and deliveries.
- Monitoring office supplies and assisting with ordering stationery and other resources.
- Supporting senior leaders and teaching staff with ad hoc administrative tasks as required.

Student Administration and Attendance
- Recording, monitoring and updating student attendance, lateness and absence information.
- Contacting parents, carers or students regarding unexplained absences, in line with college procedures.
- Processing student admissions, enrolment information, transfers and withdrawals where required.
- Supporting student registration and ensuring relevant documentation is completed accurately.
- Assisting with timetable changes, room bookings and the organisation of student appointments.
- Responding to student queries and directing them to the appropriate member of staff or support service.
- Maintaining confidentiality when handling sensitive student information.

We are looking for someone who:
- Has previous experience in an administrative or reception-based role; experience within a school, college or other educational setting would be advantageous.
- Has excellent organisational skills and strong attention to detail.
- Communicates confidently and professionally, both verbally and in writing.
- Is confident using Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and Outlook.
- Can manage competing priorities and work effectively in a busy environment.
- Demonstrates discretion and understands the importance of confidentiality and data protection.
- Has a friendly, approachable manner and enjoys working as part of a team.
- Is proactive, adaptable and able to use their own initiative.
- Understands the importance of safeguarding and maintaining a safe environment for students.
- Is reliable, punctual and committed to providing a high standard of administrative support.

To join us and be successful in this role you will need to:
- Have experience working within an administrative environment
- Enhanced DBS Disclosure, Overseas Police Clearances (if applicable) and professional reference checks
- CV must cover the full CV History
- Legal right to work in the UK

If you're an experienced or recently qualified Administrative assistant looking for an exciting new opportunity and would like to register with Tradewind Recruitment, please apply now and take the next step in your teaching career! Or for more information about the role, contact Alex Bateman on (phone number removed) / (url removed)

The benefits of joining Tradewind Recruitment;
- Your income matters; we will always seek to get you the highest rate of pay and will provide you with the best possible advice
- Your development matters; we offer our people free access to over 2,500 CPD courses, webinars and resources via the incredible National College
- Your flexibility matters; we tailor the working week to you - daily supply, long-term contracts and permanent positions available local to you
- Your wellbeing matters; we put people at the heart of everything we do and are proudly a Sunday Times Top 100 employer for 4 years running
- We pride ourselves on our exceptional service to our candidates and are proudly an Equal Opportunities Employer

title: BOM Administrator
salary_text: £28000 - £30000 per year (Regular days, 37.5 hours per week)
description:
BOM Administrator

Location: Hull, UK

Salary: 28k - 30k

A Manufacturing company is recruiting for the role of a BOM Administrator who will be responsible for the creation and maintenance of an accurate bill of materials for manufacturing and after-sales within project and production timescales.

The ideal candidate will be a highly motivated and organised individual who has can work well under pressure ensuring an excellent standard of attention to detail.

You will have the opportunity to be part of a fast-paced, dynamic environment renowned for innovation, quality construction, stylish design and outstanding value! The Product Development department generate and maintain engineering drawings and bill of materials for every model, hundreds of drawings are created, modified and issued every week.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
- Working with the Product Engineer for each product group to develop an engineering BOM for each model, providing the rest of the company with expertise and technical support.
- Ensure Safety critical and Type Approval components are accurately identified on databases and BOMs.
- Assisting the Project Manager and BOM Team Leader on measuring the progress of projects by compiling and assessing KPI's and Critical Data information.
- Create and maintain bills of material with the aid of the Product Engineer for new products.
- Assess cost, weight and complexity of new models and refine such information during product execution.
- Liaise with other members of the project team to resolve process & operational issues that inhibit effective project delivery.
- Adopt best practice tools & techniques for project information work in order to maximise efficiency and quality of output.
- Link and update parts for the After-sales and IDOL data base systems with the latest data and photographic images.
- Support the D&D Technical Support Team with information and support with direct communication with customers and dealers when requested.
- Compliance with Health & Safety requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE
- 5 GCSE or equivalent in English & Math and a high standard of further education (ONC or HNC level preferable)
- Additional qualifications or evidence of training in Data Management would be an advantage
- Familiar with BOM & database tools techniques
- Familiar with Microsoft Office programmes (Excel, Word etc)
- Ability to work under minimum supervision
- Strong problem solving & decision-making skills
- Ability to work well under pressure to achieve deadlines
- High level of accuracy in work and strong attention to detail
- Flexible, adaptable, enthusiastic and motivated
- Excellent verbal & written communication skills

BENEFITS
- 5 hour week
- 27 days annual leave plus 8 bank holidays
- Early finish Friday
- Easy access to site & free on-site parking
- Free Gym Membership

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Customer Service Advisor

Location: Hull

Salary: £26,234 per annum

Vacancy Type: Permanent, Full Time (37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday plus 1 in 6 Saturdays (8.30am - 12.30pm)

Vizion Network is a forward-thinking organisation dedicated to fostering a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Located in Hull and Wellingborough, we pride ourselves on our commitment to employee development, wellbeing, and innovation.

Our mission is to attract, develop, and retain exceptional talent by fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where every employee feels valued, respected, and empowered.

We champion equity, recognising that our strength lies in the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and talents of our people.

Through transparent practices, continuous development, and meaningful engagement, we strive to create an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute to our shared success.

To provide professional administrative support within the Claims Team and to company Management / Directors. As a Customer Service Advisor, you will deliver the highest possible standards of customer service, be able to follow individual brand requirements and directives, ensuring that service level agreements and performance targets, both on an individual and team basis are maintained. The Customer Service Advisor is responsible for deployment, management and progression of motor claims relating to vehicle accidental damage, from initial contact, to repair handover and aftercare as required, keeping in close contact with the Bodyshop/Insurer and Customer throughout the repair process to ensure all SLA's are maintained and adhered to.

Role Profile
- Ensure that you are kept fully up to date with SLA's
- Ensure that you are aware and understand the KPI's the repairers are to adhere as a Vizion Member
- Ensure accurate processing and deployment / reallocation of claim notifications to repairers via rules driven in house management system within SLA
- To ensure hire sheets are recorded and updated correctly to ensure costs to the business and clients are kept to a minimum by constant management of hire periods
- Provide investigative feedback on any queries to the company and their clients where necessary
- To progress customer claims within the company's management system ensuring they are actioned within internally agreed SLA's
- Ensure daily tasks are managed within agreed SLAs
- Management of day to day body shop performance of KPIs, breaches, and cancellations
- To be responsible for building relationships within the repair network to ensure the smooth transition of customer repairs from start to finish
- Act as a first level point of contact for repair network members, clients, customers and team members and provide progress updates as required
- To receive incoming calls and emails and act promptly, dealing with all enquiries or actions in a professional manner
- Monitor personal and general inboxes and action emails within a timely manner
- To record all client issues and feed back to your Line Manager, Network Performance Analyst and the Management Team where necessary
- Assist with any reporting requested for analysis and management of the department/region/client
- Liaise with designated Network Performance Analyst and any other departments to seek assistance and resolution where required
- Work towards achieving targets set on a daily/monthly/annual basis provided by your Team Leader/ Line Manager
- Assist with other Advisor's caseload as and when requested to ensure full service provision
- Ensure that claims data is maintained and kept fully updated with information from all sources in a timely manner
- To ensure you provide accurate and detailed recording of all information utilising our management systems so as to provide comprehensive audit trails
- Promote data security in and outside of the business at all times, strict adherence to DPA and information security standards
- Adhere to stated Company Policies and Procedures and carry out all duties in a way which is consistent with our clients' values
- The completion of duties as required from time to time by the Management Team
- Manage complaints in line with policy ensuring full and in-depth information is captured and logged to enable full reporting on Expressions of Dissatisfaction
- Ensure that you process and resolve expressions of dissatisfaction within FCA Guidelines and internal/external SLA's
- To promote our business and that of our clients by providing exceptional and friendly service at all times

Person Specification

First class communication skills

Accurate data input skills

Ability to build and maintain relationships

Ability to work to agreed deadlines, targets and objectives

Able to work as part of a team as well as autonomously to a high level of accuracy

Good planning and organisational skills

Good problem-solving skills

Good decision maker

Commitment to providing a first-class service to customers and repairers

Customer focused

Good knowledge of Microsoft Office

Closing date for applications is Monday 2nd November 2026.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Vizion Network, please click apply to be redirected to our website to complete your application.

title: Facilities Coordinator - 12 Month FTC - Hull
description:
Facilities Coordinator - 12 Month Fixed-Term Contract Location: Hull, East Yorkshire
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Job Type: Full Time 12 Month FTC
Hours: 35 hours per week
Working Pattern: Hybrid / Agile Working
Travel: Regular travel to UK offices, with occasional overnight stays

An excellent opportunity has arisen for a proactive and organised Facilities Coordinator to join the Facilities team of a well-established and forward-thinking legal services organisation based in Hull.

This is a varied and hands-on position, supporting the day-to-day management, maintenance and smooth running of multiple office locations across the UK.

Working closely with colleagues, landlords, contractors and external suppliers, you will help ensure that offices remain safe, compliant, well-maintained and efficient, while supporting facilities projects, office moves and workplace improvements.

Offering hybrid working, an excellent benefits package and exposure to multi-site facilities management, this opportunity would suit someone who enjoys a varied role combining practical problem-solving, facilities administration and health and safety responsibilities.

The Role As Facilities Coordinator, your responsibilities will include:
- Coordinating day-to-day facilities operations, building maintenance and repairs across multiple UK offices.
- Liaising with landlords, maintenance contractors, suppliers and third-party service providers.
- Supporting workplace health and safety compliance, including risk assessments and workstation assessments.
- Monitoring outstanding actions and ensuring facilities and safety issues are addressed promptly.
- Assisting with office moves, refurbishments, minor maintenance works and facilities improvement projects.
- Maintaining accurate facilities records, compliance documentation and building safety information.
- Supporting the review and development of facilities policies, procedures and processes.
- Managing facilities-related requests and tickets through Salesforce.
- Coordinating and booking complex business travel arrangements.
- Supporting internal and external events and ensuring offices operate effectively.

About You We are looking for a practical, organised and approachable individual who enjoys taking ownership of tasks and ensuring things run smoothly.

Essential requirements:
- Previous experience or a good working knowledge of office health and safety procedures.
- IOSH qualification or currently working towards one.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
- Confident communication skills and the ability to build relationships with colleagues, contractors and suppliers.
- Good IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
- A proactive, flexible and hands-on approach to problem-solving.
- Ability to work independently and make sound decisions.
- Full UK driving licence and access to a car.
- Willingness to travel regularly between UK offices, including occasional overnight stays.

Desirable experience:
- Previous experience in Facilities Coordination, Facilities Management or Office Management.
- Knowledge of Health and Safety Executive (HSE) guidance.
- First Aid at Work qualification.
- Fire Marshal training or certification.
- Experience supporting multi-site office operations.

Previous experience within a law firm or legal services organisation is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary, dependent on experience.
- 12-month fixed-term contract.
- Hybrid and agile working arrangements.
- 35-hour working week.
- Private pension.
- Medical insurance.
- Generous annual leave allowance.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Opportunity to gain experience supporting facilities operations across multiple UK locations.

Interested? If you're an experienced Facilities Coordinator, Facilities Assistant, Office Coordinator or Office Manager with a strong understanding of workplace health and safety, I'd be keen to hear from you.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a progressive organisation offering flexibility, variety and a supportive working environment.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Logistics Coordinator

Hull

Permanent Full-time

A well-established logistics business in Hull is looking to appoint a Logistics Coordinator to join its busy operations team.

This position would suit someone who enjoys working in a structured, deadline-led environment and is confident managing moving parts across transport, documentation and operational support. The hours follow a rotating pattern, so flexibility around working times is important.

The opportunity

This role centres around keeping freight movements on track from start to finish, making sure everything is lined up correctly for smooth onward movement. You will be involved in organising load activity, maintaining accurate system records, coordinating with internal departments and helping avoid disruption, delay or unnecessary spend.

Attention to detail is key, particularly where timings, system updates and operational paperwork are concerned.

- Support overall service performance by helping the team meet operational expectations and deadlines

About you

- Strong organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail
- Ability to manage live operational information accurately and efficiently
- Comfortable using internal systems and updating records in real time
- Able to work well in a fast-paced environment and respond to changing demands
- Good communication skills with a practical, team-focused approach
- Exposure to import/export activity, freight forwarding, port-related operations or logistics administration would be an advantage

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
Procurement Coordinator

Location: Site-based, Hull, HU2 8 QS

Salary: £28,000-£32,000, dependent on experience

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm

Contract: Full-time, permanent

Closing date: Sunday 1st November 2026

About FR Scott

FR Scott is one of Hull's leading independent suppliers of fixings, fasteners, architectural ironmongery, tools and industrial consumables. Established in 1945, we support customers across construction, engineering, manufacturing and modular building from our Hull trade counter, warehouse and national ecommerce operation.

The opportunity

We are looking for an organised, practical person to help keep purchasing and supply running reliably, while supporting the Head of Procurement in developing the wider function.

Day-to-day purchasing, stock availability and supplier coordination are central to this role. Alongside these responsibilities, you will support sourcing, commercial analysis, product and category development, and projects to improve how we buy and manage supply across the business.

FR Scott is a small business. Responsibilities overlap, and we need someone who takes ownership, works closely with colleagues and is willing to provide support and cover where needed. Procurement includes both the products we buy to sell and the goods and services we buy to run the business.

What you'll be doing
- Manage day-to-day purchasing and replenishment, maintaining accurate purchase orders, supplier acknowledgements, costs and delivery dates.
- Follow up outstanding orders and resolve shortages, delivery discrepancies and invoice queries, working closely with Sales, Warehouse and Finance.
- Support supplier sourcing and negotiations by obtaining and comparing quotations, benchmarking prices and identifying opportunities to improve cost, quality and availability.
- Analyse sales, stock, margin and supplier spend to support buying decisions, range reviews and commercial improvements.
- Support inventory and supplier performance reviews, helping address slow-moving stock, availability issues and recurring supply problems.
- Maintain accurate product and supplier information, including specifications, pricing and technical documentation, and support new products and range development for Fix&Fast.
- Contribute to supplier onboarding, purchasing controls, reporting and improvements to procurement processes and digital tools.
- Take responsibility for agreed suppliers, product groups and projects as your knowledge develops, providing support and cover across the wider team.

About you

You may already work in purchasing, buying or supply chain, or have relevant experience in product administration, ecommerce, sales coordination, order management or merchandising. Industry experience would be useful, but it is not essential.
- Strong attention to detail and good organisational skills.
- Confidence communicating with suppliers and colleagues and following actions through.
- Confidence using Excel to analyse sales, stock and purchasing data, compare quotations and maintain accurate records.
- An interest in products, pricing, stock and supplier performance.
- A proactive approach, commercial awareness and willingness to take ownership.

Development and progression

Working directly with the Head of Procurement, you will gain experience across buying, supplier management, stock and category development, with opportunities to take ownership of suppliers, product groups and projects as your skills grow.

This could support progression into Buyer, Category Manager or wider procurement and supply chain roles, depending on your strengths and business opportunities. Support towards a relevant CIPS qualification may be available following successful completion of probation.

What we offer
- £28,000-£32,000 salary, dependent on experience.
- 23 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service.
- Annual bonus scheme and company pension.
- Employee discount, on-site parking and sick pay.
- Training and development opportunities.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: We are seeking a dedicated and professional Part-Time Medical Receptionist to join our healthcare team here at The Avenues Medical Centre. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for patients and visitors, providing exceptional customer service while managing administrative tasks efficiently. This role is crucial in ensuring smooth operations within the GP Practice and enhancing the patients experience. Greet patients and visitors warmly, professionally and friendly ensuring a welcoming environment Manage patient check-in and check-out processes, including verifying personal information and contact details. Assisting patients using the self check-in machine in the waiting room Schedule appointments, confirm bookings, and handle cancellations or rescheduling requests Maintain accurate patient records and ensure confidentiality in accordance with the data protection regulations Answer phone calls promptly, addressing inquiries or directing calls to appropriate staff members. Including patient call backs Process incoming mail and manage correspondence effectively Process medication requests from patients Maintain an organised reception area, ensuring it is tidy and well-stocked adhering to the surgeries Clear Desk Policy Collaborate with healthcare professionals to facilitate efficient patient flow within the practice Utilise the use of our Extended Access Appointments & CDC Centre Follow and adhere to all Practice Processes, Protocols, SOPs & Practice Policies. You will also be required to keep up to date with any changes Manage the Reception Teams generic email account, action all emails accordingly and in a timely manner. Signpost and Care Navigate patients to the most appropriate care/service. This may include a Pharmacy First Referral etc Responsibilities: Manage patient check-in and check-out processes, including verifying personal information and contact details. This would also include updating the patients records where needed. Assisting patients using the self check-in machine in the waiting room Arrange/book interpreters where needed for patients using AA Global either booking via their online portal or over the telephone Maintain accurate patient records and ensure confidentiality in accordance with the data protection regulations/GDPR. Document clearly & accurately Checking on the patients record if Third Party Consent has been granted if you are not speaking to the patient directly. Should no consent be documented on the record follow the practice policy and adhere to Data Protection, GDPR and Patient Confidentiality Process incoming mail either by internal post or external post and manage correspondence effectively. Opening, date stamping, initialing and passing all documents onto the correct team Process medication requests from patients face to face at the front reception desk, online requests via System Online or the NHS App, email, telephone (certain cohorts of patients only) or paper requests Maintain an organised reception area, ensuring it is tidy and well-stocked with necessary materials adhering to the surgeries Clear Desk Policy Accepting samples at the front reception desk following the practice process and passing onto the nursing team to action Utilise the use of our Extended Access Appointments on remote booking & CDC Centre Undertake mandatory training either online or face to face when required and keeping up to date with all training. You will also be required to monitor when your training is due for renewal. Attend PTL afternoons Follow and adhere to all Practice Processes, Protocols, SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures) and Practice Policies. You will also be required to keep up to date with any changes/updates Process cash payments for Non-NHS Private work from patients which is chargeable following the practice Private Charges list. Being responsible for issuing the patient with a receipt of payment, log/document in the patients record and place all monies in the secure Private Money Box, maintaining the money is kept secure & safe. Support the GP Partners and Nursing Team to chaperone in appointments as needed once you have undertaken the relevant training. Signpost and Care Navigate patients to the most appropriate care/service. This may include a Pharmacy First Referral, signpost to NHS111, Urgent Care etc Action tasks and other duties assigned to your work station that day.
